source.locator: Theorem 1, equation (2.3), specialized to independent Bernoulli summands; lower tail by applying the same bound to 1-X_i
source.verbatim_statement: Theorem 1. If X₁, X₂, ···, Xₙ are independent and 0 ≤ Xᵢ ≤ 1 for i = 1, ···, n, then, for 0 < t < 1 − μ, Pr{X̄ − μ ≥ t} ≤ e^{-2nt²}.

attestation.note: Verified against Hoeffding (1963), JASA 58(301), journal p.15, Theorem 1 and equation (2.3), public scan at https://www.cs.rpi.edu/academics/courses/spring06/random/hoefding.pdf. For Bernoulli X_i, μ=p; the lower-tail inequality is the same displayed result applied to independent complemented Bernoulli variables 1-X_i.
